title: SPFuzz: Stateful Path based Parallel Fuzzing for Protocols in Autonomous Vehicles
problem: Fuzzing optimizations for in-vehicle network protocols struggle to manage complex protocol state transitions, resulting in low branch coverage efficiency and reduced vulnerability detection effectiveness.
motivation: Protocols in autonomous vehicles require rigorous security testing to ensure safe and reliable in-vehicle network communication.
method: SPFuzz combines stateful path-based guidance to track protocol state machines with parallel fuzzing to explore multiple execution paths concurrently. The approach prioritizes test cases that exercise state transitions and uses path coverage metrics to guide input generation toward uncovered branches.
key_novelty: Integration of stateful path guidance with parallel fuzzing to efficiently explore complex protocol state spaces.
contributions: Stateful fuzzing framework specifically designed for protocol state machines
Path-based guidance mechanism for improved branch coverage in stateful systems
Parallel fuzzing architecture for accelerated vulnerability discovery
Evaluation on automotive vehicle protocols demonstrating improved efficiency over existing approaches

metrics.other: branch coverage and state transition coverage

primary_theme: stateful parallel fuzzing for automotive protocols
